title: mostacillastrum ekmanii
intro: Mostacillastrum ekmanii, commonly known as the "Andean plant," is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is native to the Andes mountains in South America. The health benefits of Mostacillastrum ekmanii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, wounds, and respiratory issues.
